title: Plugin View Declaration
description: EP-05: one entry of a plugin manifest's provides.views. in-process-a2ui views are declarative A2UI documents rendered with the kyberion-base catalog and never execute plugin code; PH-02 sandboxed-iframe views are one self-contained HTML document served with a sandbox CSP in an opaque-origin iframe. Validated by libs/core/plugin-view-contract.ts (and plugin-view-frame.ts), which also enforces the document, vocabulary, capability and action rules this schema cannot express.

id.description: View id, unique within the plugin.

titleKey.description: user-facing-vocabulary key (namespace:key or unambiguous bare key) for the view title.

document.description: Plugin-relative path of the view document (always under views/): *.a2ui.json for in-process-a2ui, *.html (<= 512KB UTF-8) for sandboxed-iframe.

isolation.description: Rendering isolation. in-process-a2ui renders the A2UI document inside the host surface; sandboxed-iframe renders the HTML document in an iframe sandboxed to allow-scripts only (opaque origin, no network, host-mediated postMessage).

capabilities.description: Additional host capabilities the view requests. Deny by default; the allowlist is ["action.request"] (an iframe view may ask the host to run one of its declared actions, always host-confirmed). Any other entry is rejected.

tiers.description: Every tier the view may display; the viewer must hold all of them.

authority.description: human = the action is queued as a human approval request; agent = dispatched directly when the plugin is active.

op.description: Operation the action invokes; must be one of the plugin's own provides.ops.

paramsSchema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) for the action params; every object schema must set additionalProperties:false.
